mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 55 degrees.

Public Works has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching various streets, including Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, so please respect the no parking signs from 7 AM to 7 PM.

We have a busy schedule ahead! You can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking forward, there is yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, followed by a variety of trivia nights and live music performances this Wednesday.
The Verona Police Department reported that on October 23, two 13-year-olds were contacted for riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents.
Today's delicious flavor is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight, so stop by for a treat.
